title: Entrepreneurship and Innovation, Minor (Intercollege)
notes: Substituted for a plain 'Entrepreneurship, Minor', which does not have its own real bulletin page at University Park -- the real, interdisciplinary University Park version is 'Entrepreneurship and Innovation, Minor' (ENTI), open to students in any major. 18-20cr total. Prescribed: ENGR 310 (3cr) + MGMT 215 (3cr) + the cross-listed 'ENGR/IST/MGMT 425' (used MGMT 425; its own prereq is satisfied by MGMT 215, already in this same minor). Additional: 'Select 9+ credits from one of 10 clusters' (Bio-Tech, Enterprise AI, Energy Transition, Entrepreneurship as Advocacy, Food and Bio-innovation, Hospitality Management, New Media, New Ventures, Product Innovation, Social Entrepreneurship) -- the bulletin page names the clusters but publishes no course list for any of them (adviser-driven, 'each cluster is structured to provide a clear course path' per the bulletin's own footnote); modeled as 3 generic 3cr slots (9cr, matching the range's stated lower bound), same convention as every other unenumerated elective pool this session.
